question.problem:
Find the characteristic equation of the matrix 
$B=[\begin{aligned}2 & 5 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & -1 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
First, we find the matrix $\,B-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
B-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 5 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & -1-\lambda  & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5-\lambda  & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

The characteristic equation is $det(B-\lambda I)=0.$ 

Since the determinant of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix is given by the product of the entries on the main diagonal, we obtain the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}det(B-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 5 & 4 & 2 \\ 0 & -1-\lambda  & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5-\lambda  & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 1-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(-1-\lambda )(5-\lambda )(1-\lambda ) & =0 \\ (\lambda -2)(\lambda +1)(\lambda -5)(\lambda -1) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
